title: Sales Executive
summary: Support enquiries and quotations for metal roofing, doors and frames.
description: Support customers with product enquiries and coordinate quotations with the relevant teams.
responsibilities:
Respond to product enquiries and coordinate follow-up.
Help prepare quotations with the relevant team.
Maintain accurate customer and enquiry information.
requirements:
Clear communication and organisational skills.
Willingness to learn about building products.

title: Production Operator
summary: Support the production of metal roofing, doors and frames.
description: Support production activities while following safety and quality procedures.
responsibilities:
Assist with assigned production activities under supervision.
Follow approved safety and quality procedures.
Keep the assigned work area organised.
requirements:
Attention to detail and willingness to follow safety instructions.
Ability to work cooperatively with a production team.

title: Administrative Assistant
summary: Support office coordination, documentation and administrative follow-up.
description: Support day-to-day office coordination, records and correspondence.
responsibilities:
Help organise office documents and records.
Support routine internal coordination.
Assist with correspondence and administrative follow-up.
requirements:
Organisational skills and attention to detail.
Clear written and verbal communication.
